Game Overview

Sunset Katana is a ninja game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Sunset Katana comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Sunset Katana?

Sunset Katana is a free ninja game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Sunset Katana free to play?

Yes, Sunset Katana is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
